title: Fire Breaks Out at Store in Centro Histórico
detail: A fire broke out on July 4, 2026, at a commercial store at the intersection of República de Perú and República de Chile streets in Mexico City's Centro Histórico. Firefighters from Bomberos CDMX responded and contained the blaze; no injuries were reported. The suspected cause was a short circuit, though this had not been officially confirmed by authorities.

media.caption: Firefighters respond to a store fire in Centro Histórico, Mexico City
